title: PORT-BRANCH-parked-claude-repos-spec: carry parked/claude/repos-spec onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `parked/claude/repos-spec` at 3b6caafd5a holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: README.md, brand/brand.json, brand/generated/repo-map.svg, brand/repos/.github/README.block.md, brand/repos/license/README.block.md, brand/repos/ops/README.block.md)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried parked/claude/repos-spec
**Status:** closed

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 2 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried parked/claude/repos-spec

**Evidence:** Superseded: main already has specs/US-SPEC-*.md, SCOPE.md, docs/spec/ and licensing/ (REPOS-1 spec fold).
